title: DuckDuckGo search saw 28% more visits after Google said people love AI mode
summary: DuckDuckGo experienced a nearly 28% increase in web traffic following Google's public insistence that users love their new AI mode, highlighting a growing user preference for traditional, AI-free search experiences amid increasing AI integration in search engines.
problem_solved: Addresses the gap in user demand for AI-free search alternatives as major search engines push AI integration.
why_valuable: Demonstrates market demand for privacy-focused, AI-free search and validates DuckDuckGo's positioning as an alternative for users skeptical of AI-heavy search experiences.
